title: Proteomics Study of Gastric Bypass Surgery to Treat Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to reveal the key proteins involved in gastric bypassing surgery which may effect the decreased glucose in type 2 diabetes patietns, and evaluate standard remission rate as well as cost-benefit of gastric bypassing surgery for type 2 diabetes mellitus patients in China.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients diagnosed as type 2 diabetes are planning to have Roux-en-Y gastric bypass
* age:18-65yr
* HbAlc\>8%

Exclusion Criteria:

* diabetes (applies for control patients)
* chronic inflammatory disease
* malignant disease
* pregnancy
* prior gastric, duodenal, proximal jejunal surgery or pancreas resection
* current use of thiazolidinediones
* treatment with incretin mimetics or DPP IV inhibitors in the prior 3 months
* HbAlc\<8%
* any condition felt by the investigator to interfere with ability to complete the study
study_population: all patients are recruited from No. 150 Central Hospital of PLA
